title: TTA-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Text-to-Audio Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using two approaches: 1) Fairness evaluation by constructing paired prompts with gender-specific pronouns to assess quality consistency across male and female subgroups, and 2) Bias evaluation by providing explicitly gender-neutral prompts and measuring skewed associations or gender favoritism in the generated audio outputs using Median Absolute Deviation (MAD).

Evaluated by systematically replacing subject terms in prompts with age-specific words to create demographic subgroups (Old, Middle-aged, Youth, and Child) and measuring the variation in quality evaluation metrics across these groups.

Evaluated by constructing prompt templates specifying different target languages (English, Chinese, and various low-resource languages like German, Spanish, Korean, Arabic, and Hindi) to compare the consistency of model performance and output fairness across languages.
